fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Drive; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Detached Structure; Dense Vegetation; Landscaped Area
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Dense Vegetation; Limited Turnaround Space; Detached Structure Complexity
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions of the road.
• Mark the entrance to the detached structure with a reflective address or unit marker so responders can locate it quickly at night or in low visibility.
• Clear vegetation along the sides of the access drive so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Trim dense vegetation near the detached structure to open a clear path for responders approaching on foot.
• Keep a minimum 10-foot-wide path on the access drive free of parked vehicles, equipment, and debris at all times.
• Designate and mark a flat, stable area near the access drive where emergency vehicles can turn around.
• Keep all gates between the main residence and detached structure unlocked or equipped with a lock box accessible to responders.
• Trim shrubs and low-hanging branches along walkways connecting the main residence to the detached structure.
• Post a simple site map near the driveway entrance showing the location of the main residence, detached structure, and any secondary access points.
• Mark secondary access points with reflective markers so responders can identify alternate routes onto the property.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Trees; Tree Cluster; Tree Cluster; Vegetation Near Structure; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Along Driveway; Open Terrain; Multiple Access Routes; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Scattered Shrubs
wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees in the clusters near the structures to create more open space between them.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against or immediately next to any structure.
• Trim overhanging branches and cut back shrubs along the driveway to keep it clear for vehicle access.
• Separate scattered trees from nearby structures by removing the closest trees or heavy lower limbs.
• Keep the open terrain areas between vegetation and structures free of accumulated dead leaves, branches, and debris.
